caption:
Bhindi Masala
Do you remember the first time you ever cooked bhindi? i do! i obvvv googled and read how to clean and cook it but staying honest, the first time i made it i cut them way too big and they didnt all cook and i ended up making the first dish  that we couldnt eat! 

Ingredients: 
1.5 tbsp oil to fry the bhindi
200 -250 grams bhindi 
1 tsp ghee
1 onion, finely chopped
1 tsp ginger-garlic paste
2 green chillies, finely chopped
2 tomatoes, finely chopped
1/2 tsp red chilli powder
1/2 tsp turmeric powder
1 tsp garam masala
1 tsp jeera powder
1 tsp aamchur powder
salt to taste
chopped coriander leaves or garnish

Method: 
rise the bhindi and then dry it completely ( if still wet, it will be a hastle to use)
cut your dried bhindi into 1 inch pieces removing the stalk and base
fry in the oil till the bhindi cooks, ensure you keep stiring it and do not leave it stagnent for too long, you could risk burning it, take out once done and set aside
in the same pan, add in your ghee + onions+gg paste + chillies and saute till onions go translucent
add in your tomato + masalas and cook till the tomatoes go soft
add in your cooked bhindi and mix well, allow to cook together for 2-3 minutes and top with fresh coriander leaves and serve it hot with my favorite dal + chawal
